render_tooling: LibreOffice headless conversion for Office files

cases.name: BI QRIS Office Matrix
cases.source: downloads/ease-bi/dokumen-persyaratan-pedoman/2. Dokumen Pedoman dan Persyaratan Permohonan Persetujuan dan Pelaporan SP Ritel/j. Matriks Tambahan Dokumen Pengembangan QRIS.docx
cases.visual_finding: Table is legible with clear columns for requirement, document availability, and explanation.
cases.extraction_risk: LiteParse captures the table as Markdown, but metadata fields above the table are flattened and may lose label/value pairing.

cases.name: BI SNAP Office Matrix
cases.source: downloads/ease-bi/dokumen-persyaratan-pedoman/4. Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran (SNAP)/Matriks Tambahan_Pengembangan dengan SNAP.docx
cases.visual_finding: Page 1 is a clear table. Pages 2-3 are continuation pages with most useful text in the rightmost explanation column and mostly blank left columns.
cases.extraction_risk: Continuation pages can lose row/column context; page 3 has table borders visually but weak table markers in extracted Markdown.

cases.name: BI SNAP Functional Test XLSX
cases.source: downloads/ease-bi/dokumen-persyaratan-pedoman/4. Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran (SNAP)/Skenario Functional Test_v.2810.xlsx
cases.visual_finding: Page 1 is a linked table of contents. Pages 2-3 are clean spreadsheet tables. Page 3 starts mid-table.
cases.extraction_risk: Extracted Markdown rows are useful, but page-boundary continuation creates synthetic table starts and can separate rows from the original header.

cases.name: OJK GMRA Attachment
cases.visual_finding: Bilingual two-column layout is visually legible. Text is dense and aligned by paragraph pairs.
cases.extraction_risk: Reading order can interleave English and Indonesian column text; retrieval remains useful, but answer snippets may mix languages or split paired clauses.

findings: No rendered sample showed clipped text, black pages, unreadable glyphs, or failed Office conversion.
The recovered QRIS/SNAP Office files are visually valid and searchable enough for the current baseline.
The weakest area is table continuity, especially continuation pages where the header row is absent or where the source page starts in the middle of an XLSX table.
GMRA-style bilingual attachments need caution because visual columns do not always map cleanly to single-language answer snippets.
decision: Keep LiteParse plus selective PaddleOCR as the baseline. Do not add MinerU to the active path for this corpus on the current local machine.
follow_up_work: Add table-continuation handling for XLSX pages that start mid-table.
Preserve table headers across page boundaries for Office and spreadsheet conversions.
Add a targeted check for bilingual two-column pages so final answer snippets prefer Indonesian text when available.
Keep visual spot checks as a regression gate when extraction heuristics change.
